﴿أتى أمر الله فلا تستعجلوه﴾: أتى is a past verb; أمر الله is its fāʿil (agent); the fāʾ is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تستعجلوه is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; the wāw is the agent; and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿سبحانه وتعالى عما يشركون﴾: سبحانه: standing as deputy for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); تعالى is a past verb; ﴿عما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿سبحانه﴾ or to ﴿تعالى﴾; ما is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya) or relative (mawṣūla); and the clause يشركون has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿ينزل الملائكة بالروح من أمره على من يشاء من عباده﴾: ﴿ينزل الملائكة﴾ is a verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بالروح﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿ينزل﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "invested with the Spirit"; ﴿من أمره﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿على من يشاء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينزل﴾; and ﴿من عباده﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿أن أنذروا﴾: ﴿أن﴾: explicative (tafsīriyya), because الروح means revelation, and revelation contains the meaning of speech; ﴿أنذروا﴾: an imperative verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause ﴿أنذروا﴾ is explicative with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), and the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن أنذروا﴾ is a badal (substitute) from الروح, genitive (majrūr); and the clause ﴿أنذروا﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdar-forming ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿أنه لا إله إلا أنا فاتقون﴾: ﴿أن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the hāʾ is the noun (ism) of أن; the clause ﴿لا إله إلا أنا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of أن; ﴿لا﴾ is the lā of generic negation; ﴿إله﴾ is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); ﴿أنا﴾ is a badal from the position of ﴿لا﴾ and its noun; ﴿فاتقون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; اتقون is an imperative verb and agent; the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya); and the yāʾ of the first person has been deleted in keeping with the verse-endings (fawāṣil).

muyesser-irab:3-3.t: ﴿خلق السماوات والأرض بالحق تعالى عما يشركون﴾: ﴿خلق السماوات والأرض﴾ is a verb and a latent (mustatir) agent; السماوات is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الأرض is conjoined to السماوات; ﴿بالحق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "rightfully"; تعالى is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو); ﴿عما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تعالى﴾; and the clause يشركون is a ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t: ﴿خلق الإنسان من نطفة فإذا هو خصيم مبين﴾: ﴿خلق الإنسان﴾ is a verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من نطفة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿خلق﴾, and من is for the starting point (ibtidāʾ); ﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is the [إذا] of surprise (fujāʾiyya); ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); خصيم is the khabar (predicate); and مبين is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿والأنعام خلقها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الأنعام is accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb indicated by what follows it. The clause of the omitted verb is conjoined to His saying ﴿خلق الإنسان﴾ in the previous verse. خلقها: a verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿خلقها﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya) with no grammatical position.
﴿لكم فيها دفء ومنافع﴾: ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); دفء is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause is circumstantial, or resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position. Or ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl of دفء, and ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; and منافع is conjoined to دفء.
﴿ومنها تأكلون﴾: ﴿منها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تأكلون﴾; and تأكلون is an imperfect verb and fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿ولكم فيها جمال حين تريحون وحين تسرحون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); جمال is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); حين is an adverb attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective); the clause تريحون is that to which it is annexed (muḍāf ilayhi); and likewise His saying: ﴿وحين تسرحون﴾.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿وتحمل أثقالكم إلى بلد لم تكونوا بالغيه إلا بشق الأنفس﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; تحمل أثقالكم is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿إلى بلد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿تحمل﴾; the clause ﴿لم تكونوا بالغيه﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of بلد; ﴿بالغيه﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of تكونوا; إلا is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); and ﴿بشق الأنفس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the nominative pronoun in ﴿بالغيه﴾, i.e. "with hardship upon you".
﴿إن ربكم لرءوف رحيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ربكم is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and رءوف رحيم are two khabars.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿والخيل والبغال والحمير لتركبوها وزينة﴾: ﴿والخيل﴾ and what follows it are conjoined to الأنعام, i.e. "and He created these for riding and adornment"; ﴿لتركبوها﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation (taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an accusative [word that is a] mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); ﴿زينة﴾ is conjoined to the position of ﴿لتركبوها﴾; and it is also said that it is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in ﴿تركبوها﴾.
﴿ويخلق ما لا تعلمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿وعلى الله قصد السبيل ومنها جائر﴾: ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿قصد السبيل﴾ is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿منها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; and جائر is a naʿt (adjective) of a qualified noun which is the postponed mubtadaʾ, i.e. "a deviating way".
﴿ولو شاء لهداكم أجمعين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لو is a conditional [particle] of impossibility (imtināʿiyya); the object of ﴿شاء﴾ is omitted, i.e. "had He willed your guidance"; the lām links (rābiṭa) the apodosis of ﴿لو﴾; هداكم is a verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and أجمعين is a tawkīd (emphasis).

muyesser-irab:10-10.t: ﴿هو الذي أنزل من السماء ماء لكم منه شراب ومنه شجر فيه تسيمون﴾: ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿الذي﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the clause أنزل is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; ﴿من السماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to أنزل; ماء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of شراب; شراب is the postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿لكم منه شراب﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ماء; ﴿منه شجر﴾ is a resumptive clause (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position, composed of a fronted khabar and a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تسيمون﴾; and the clause تسيمون is a naʿt of شجر.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿ينبت لكم به الزرع والزيتون والنخيل والأعناب ومن كل الثمرات﴾: ينبت is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿ينبت﴾; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينبت﴾, and the bāʾ is causal, i.e. "by means of it the trees grow"; الزرع is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الزيتون, النخيل and الأعناب are conjoined to الزرع; and ﴿من كل الثمرات﴾ is likewise conjoined to what precedes.
﴿إن في ذلك لآية لقوم يتفكرون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿آية﴾ is the postponed noun (ism) of إن; ﴿لقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية; and the clause يتفكرون is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿وسخر لكم الليل والنهار والشمس والقمر﴾: ﴿وسخر لكم الليل﴾ is a verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿سخر﴾; and الشمس and القمر are conjoined to الليل and النهار.
﴿والنجوم مسخرات بأمره﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; النجوم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); مسخرات is the khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined to the previous clause; and ﴿بأمره﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مسخرات﴾.
﴿إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يعقلون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted fronted khabar; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آيات is the postponed noun (ism) of إن; ﴿لقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آيات; and the clause يعقلون is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿وما ذرأ لكم في الأرض مختلفا ألوانه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is conjoined to ﴿الليل والنهار﴾ in the previous verse; it is also said that it is accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb, i.e. "and He created and caused to grow"; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿ذرأ﴾; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿ذرأ﴾; مختلفًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and ألوانه is the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿مختلفًا﴾.
﴿إن في ذلك لآية لقوم يذكرون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آية is the postponed noun (ism) of إن; ﴿لقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية; and the clause يذكرون is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿وهو الذي سخر البحر لتأكلوا منه لحما طريا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); الذي is the khabar (predicate); the clause سخر is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; البحر is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لتأكلوا﴾: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and تأكلوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿سخر﴾; ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تأكلوا﴾; لحمًا is the direct object; and طريًّا is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿وتستخرجوا منه حلية تلبسونها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; تستخرجوا is conjoined to لتأكلوا; ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تستخرجوا﴾; حلية is the direct object; and the clause تلبسونها is a naʿt of ﴿حلية﴾.
﴿وترى الفلك مواخر فيه ولتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون﴾: the wāw is parenthetical; ترى الفلك: a verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a direct object; the clause ﴿وترى الفلك﴾ is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya) with no grammatical position; مواخر: a ḥāl (circumstantial), because the seeing is visual; ﴿فيه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مواخر﴾; ﴿لتبتغوا﴾ is conjoined to لتأكلوا; لعل is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the kāf is its noun (ism); and the clause تشكرون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿وألقى في الأرض رواسي أن تميد بكم﴾: ﴿وألقى﴾ is conjoined to ﴿وسخر﴾; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ألقى; رواسي is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. "firm mountains"; أن and what falls in its scope is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "out of aversion to its swaying with you and shaking"; and ﴿بكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تميد﴾.
﴿وأنهارا وسبلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنهارًا and سبلًا are conjoined to رواسي, or are the direct object of an omitted verb, the implied form being: «وجعل فيها» ("and He made in it").
﴿لعلكم تهتدون﴾: لعل is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the kāf is its noun (ism); and the clause تهتدون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:16-16.t: ﴿وعلامات وبالنجم هم يهتدون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; علامات is conjoined to ﴿رواسي﴾; ﴿بالنجم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يهتدون﴾; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿يهتدون﴾ is its khabar (predicate). It is also said that [علامات] is the object of an omitted verb, i.e. "and He placed in it landmarks".

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿أفمن يخلق كمن لا يخلق﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of denial (istifhām inkārī); the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted; ﴿مَن﴾: a relative noun in the position of a nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يخلق﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿كمن﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and مَن is a relative noun in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿لا يخلق﴾ is a ṣila of the second ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿أفلا تذكرون﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of denial; the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿لا﴾ is negative; ﴿تذكرون﴾ is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿وإن تعدوا نعمة الله لا تحصوها﴾: a resumptive clause (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; تعدوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); نعمة الله is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); لا is negative; تحصوها is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the wāw is the agent; and ﴿ها﴾ is the direct object.
﴿إن الله لغفور رحيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis; غفور is the first khabar (predicate) of إن, and رحيم is its second khabar.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t: ﴿والله يعلم ما تسرون وما تعلنون﴾: ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يعلم is the khabar (predicate); the fāʿil (agent) of يعلم is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); ﴿ما﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause تسرون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and ﴿ما تعلنون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ما تسرون﴾.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t: ﴿والذين يدعون من دون الله لا يخلقون شيئا وهم يخلقون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يدعون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿من دون الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿لا يخلقون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of الذين; شيئًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ; ﴿يخلقون﴾ is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); and the clause ﴿يخلقون﴾ is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿أموات غير أحياء وما يشعرون أيان يبعثون﴾: أموات is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); it is also said to be a second khabar of ﴿الذين﴾ in the previous verse; ﴿غير أحياء﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of أموات, intended for emphasis; ﴿ما يشعرون﴾ is conjoined to أموات, or is a third khabar of ﴿الذين﴾; ﴿أيان﴾ is an adverb of ﴿يبعثون﴾, so it is attached (mutaʿalliq) to it; and the wāw refers back to the idols.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿إلهكم إله واحد﴾: إلهكم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إله is the khabar (predicate); and واحد is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿فالذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة قلوبهم منكرة﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; الذين is the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿لا يؤمنون بالآخرة﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; قلوبهم is a mubtadaʾ; منكرة is the khabar of قلوبهم; and the nominal clause is the khabar of الذين.
﴿وهم مستكبرون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ; مستكبرون is the khabar; and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿لا جرم أن الله يعلم ما يسرون وما يعلنون﴾: لا is negative; جرم is a past verb; أن and what falls in its scope is its fāʿil (agent); the clause يعلم is the khabar (predicate) of أن; the clause يسرون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and ﴿ما يعلنون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ما يسرون﴾.
﴿إنه لا يحب المستكبرين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the hāʾ is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿لا يحب﴾ is its khabar; and المستكبرين is the object of يحب.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t: ﴿وإذا قيل لهم ماذا أنزل ربكم قالوا أساطير الأولين﴾: إذا is an adverb of future time; the clause ﴿قيل لهم﴾ is that to which the adverb is annexed (muḍāf ilayhi); the clause ﴿ماذا أنزل ربكم﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of ﴿قيل﴾; the speech is resumptive (mustaʾnaf) with no grammatical position; ﴿ماذا﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative as the fronted object of أنزل; or ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, and ﴿ذا﴾ is a relative noun in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate); ﴿أنزل ربكم﴾ is a verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position; and ﴿أساطير الأولين﴾ is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "they are the tales of the ancients", or: "what was sent down is the tales of the ancients".

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿ليحملوا أوزارهم كاملة يوم القيامة﴾: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl); يحملوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿قالوا﴾; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); أوزارهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); كاملة is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿يوم القيامة﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿يحملوا﴾. It is also said that the lām is for consequence (ʿāqiba).
﴿ومن أوزار الذين يضلونهم بغير علم ألا ساء ما يزرون﴾: ﴿ومن أوزار﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أوزارهم﴾, so the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يحملوا﴾; من is partitive, i.e. "and some of the burdens of those who go astray through their leading astray"; it is also said that it is for the genus, i.e. "so that they bear [something] of the genus of the burdens of the disbelievers"; the clause ﴿يضلونهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿بغير علم﴾ is a ḥāl of the direct object, and it is also said: of the agent to whom the leading astray is attributed; ﴿ألا﴾ is a particle of alerting (tanbīh); ﴿ساء﴾ is a past verb for expressing blame; ﴿ما﴾ is a tamyīz (specification), i.e. "a thing", and the clause ﴿يزرون﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ما﴾; or ﴿ما﴾ is the agent of ﴿ساء﴾, and the clause ﴿يزرون﴾ is its ṣila, with no grammatical position; and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "their burden" (وزرهم).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿قد مكر الذين من قبلهم فأتى الله بنيانهم من القواعد﴾: a resumptive clause (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); مكر الذين is a verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿من قبلهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿فأتى الله بنيانهم﴾ is a verb, agent and mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it is conjoined to what precedes; and ﴿من القواعد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أتى﴾.
﴿فخر عليهم السقف من فوقهم وأتاهم العذاب من حيث لا يشعرون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿خر﴾ is a past verb; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خر﴾; السقف is the agent; ﴿من فوقهم﴾ is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿أتاهم العذاب﴾ is a past verb, a fronted direct object and a postponed agent; ﴿من حيث﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أتاهم﴾; and the clause ﴿لا يشعرون﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿ثم يوم القيامة يخزيهم﴾: ثم is a conjunction; ﴿يوم﴾ is an adverb attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يخزيهم﴾; القيامة is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and يخزيهم is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ويقول أين شركائي الذين كنتم تشاقون فيهم﴾: أين is an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative as an adverb of place, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); شركائي is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of شركائي; the clause ﴿كنتم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the clause تشاقون is the khabar of كنتم; and ﴿فيهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تشاقون﴾.
﴿قال الذين أوتوا العلم إن الخزي اليوم والسوء على الكافرين﴾: ﴿قال الذين﴾ is a verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أوتوا﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); العلم is the second direct object; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الخزي is its noun (ism); اليوم is an adverb attached to الخزي, because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) that governs as the verb does; السوء is conjoined to الخزي; and ﴿على الكافرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿الذين تتوفاهم الملائكة ظالمي أنفسهم﴾: الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الكافرين﴾ in the previous verse, or a badal (substitute) from it; the clause ﴿تتوفاهم الملائكة﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position, and the clause is a verb, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and fāʿil (agent); ظالمي أنفسهم is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of تتوفاهم; and أنفسهم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فألقوا السلم ما كنا نعمل من سوء﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ألقوا is conjoined to توفاهم; it is also said that ﴿ألقوا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿قال الذين أوتوا العلم﴾; and it is also said that the fāʾ is resumptive and the clause ﴿فألقوا السلم﴾ is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; ﴿ألقوا﴾ is a verb and agent; السلم is the direct object; the clause ﴿ما كنا﴾ is the speech reported (maqūl) of an omitted saying, i.e. "saying"; ﴿ما﴾ is negative; ﴿كنا﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿نعمل﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كنا; من is a connective (ṣila) [i.e. redundant]; and ﴿سوء﴾ is genitive in form and accusative in position as the direct object.
﴿بلى إن الله عليم بما كنتم تعملون﴾: بلى: a particle of answer, to cancel the negation in their saying ﴿ما كنا نعمل من سوء﴾; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the Name of Majesty is its noun; عليم is its khabar; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿عليم﴾; the clause ﴿كنتم تعملون﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the clause تعملون is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿فادخلوا أبواب جهنم خالدين فيها﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; ادخلوا is an imperative verb and fāʿil (agent); أبواب is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); جهنم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); خالدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of ادخلوا; and ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿خالدين﴾.
﴿فلبئس مثوى المتكبرين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); بئس is a past verb for expressing blame; مثوى المتكبرين is the agent; and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "it" (هي).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿وقيل للذين اتقوا ماذا أنزل ربكم قالوا خيرا﴾: ﴿قيل﴾ is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); ﴿للذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿قيل﴾; the clause ﴿اتقوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿ماذا﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative as the fronted object of ﴿أنزل﴾; or ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿ذا﴾ is a relative noun in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate); ﴿أنزل ربكم﴾ is a verb and fāʿil (agent); and خيرًا is the object of an omitted verb, i.e. "He sent down good".
﴿للذين أحسنوا في هذه الدنيا حسنة﴾: ﴿للذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; the clause ﴿أحسنوا﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿في هذه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أحسنوا﴾; الدنيا is a badal (substitute); حسنة is the postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause ﴿للذين أحسنوا...﴾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) with no grammatical position.
﴿ولدار الآخرة خير﴾: the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); دار الآخرة is the mubtadaʾ; and ﴿خير﴾ is the khabar.
﴿ولنعم دار المتقين﴾: the lām is the lām of inception; ﴿نعم﴾ is a past verb for expressing praise; ﴿دار المتقين﴾ is the agent; and the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, i.e. "it" (هي).

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿جنات عدن يدخلونها﴾: جنات is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); or it is the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ), and so is parsed as a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause ﴿نعم دار المتقين﴾; or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ; and the clause ﴿يدخلونها﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). [Translator's note: the source gives the first option, "the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ", twice.]
﴿تجري من تحتها الأنهار لهم فيها ما يشاءون﴾: the clause ﴿تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾ is likewise a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; the clause ﴿لهم فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted third ḥāl [Translator's note: so worded in the source, which calls the clause "a preposition and its genitive noun"; the intent appears to be that the clause ﴿لهم فيها ما يشاءون﴾ is a third ḥāl]; ﴿ما﴾ is the postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause ﴿يشاءون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿كذلك يجزي الله المتقين﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "with a recompense like that He recompenses"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; and ﴿يجزي الله المتقين﴾ is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿الذين تتوفاهم الملائكة طيبين﴾: الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿المتقين﴾ in the previous verse, or a badal (substitute) from it; the clause ﴿تتوفاهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الملائكة is the fāʿil (agent); and طيبين is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object in ﴿تتوفاهم﴾, i.e. "pure of blemishes".
﴿يقولون سلام عليكم ادخلوا الجنة بما كنتم تعملون﴾: the clause ﴿يقولون﴾ is a ḥāl of الملائكة; سلام is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate); ادخلوا الجنة is an imperative verb, agent and direct object; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ادخلوا﴾; the clause كنتم is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the clause تعملون is the khabar of كنتم. It is also said that ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya).

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿هل ينظرون إلا أن تأتيهم الملائكة أو يأتي أمر ربك﴾: هل is an interrogative particle whose meaning is negation; ينظرون is an imperfect verb and fāʿil (agent); إلا is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن﴾ and what falls in its scope is the object of ينظرون; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; and ﴿يأتي أمر ربك﴾ is conjoined to ﴿تأتيهم الملائكة﴾.
﴿كذلك فعل الذين من قبلهم﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), or in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿فعل الذين﴾ is a verb and agent; and ﴿من قبلهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿وما ظلمهم الله﴾: the wāw is parenthetical; ما is negative; ﴿ظلمهم الله﴾ is a verb, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and agent; and the clause is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya) with no grammatical position.
﴿ولكن كانوا أنفسهم يظلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لكن﴾ is lightened, non-governing (muhmala); كانوا is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; the wāw is its noun (ism); the clause يظلمون is its khabar (predicate); ﴿أنفسهم﴾ is the fronted object of His saying ﴿يظلمون﴾; and the clause is conjoined to the parenthetical clause, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿فأصابهم سيئات ما عملوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿أصابهم﴾ is a verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); سيئات is the fāʿil (agent); and ﴿ما﴾ is relative (mawṣūla) or maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya).
﴿وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزئون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿بهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿حاق﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is the agent; the clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يستهزئون﴾; and the clause يستهزئون is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿وقال الذين أشركوا لو شاء الله ما عبدنا من دونه من شيء نحن ولا آباؤنا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; ﴿قال الذين﴾ is a verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أشركوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿لو﴾ is a conditional [particle] of impossibility (imtināʿiyya); ﴿شاء الله﴾ is a verb and agent, and the object is omitted, i.e. "had He willed other than our way and what issues from us"; ﴿ما﴾ is negative; ﴿عبدنا﴾ is a verb and agent; ﴿من دونه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿من﴾ is a connective (ṣila) [i.e. redundant]; ﴿شيء﴾ is genitive in form and the object of عبدنا in position; ﴿نحن﴾ is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the agent of ﴿عبدنا﴾; ﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and ﴿لا﴾ is negative; and ﴿آباؤنا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿نحن﴾.
﴿ولا حرمنا من دونه من شيء﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿حرمنا﴾ is a verb and agent; ﴿من دونه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of ﴿شيء﴾; من is a connective (ṣila) preposition [i.e. redundant]; and شيء is genitive in form, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative in position.
﴿كذلك فعل الذين من قبلهم﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "those before them did a doing like that doing"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿فعل الذين﴾ is a verb and agent; and ﴿من قبلهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿فهل على الرسل إلا البلاغ المبين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; هل is an interrogative particle whose meaning is negation; ﴿على الرسل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); إلا is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); البلاغ is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and المبين is its naʿt.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿ولقد بعثنا في كل أمة رسولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām occurs in the answer to an implied (muqaddar) oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); ﴿بعثنا﴾ is a verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿في كل أمة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿بعثنا﴾; and رسولًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أن اعبدوا الله واجتنبوا الطاغوت﴾: أن is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), and together with what it governs it is a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿بعثنا﴾; the clause ﴿اعبدوا الله﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdar-forming أن, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), because sending contains the meaning of speech, and the clause after it is explicative with no grammatical position. ﴿اعبدوا﴾ is an imperative verb and agent; the Name of Majesty is the direct object; and ﴿اجتنبوا الطاغوت﴾ is an imperative verb, agent and direct object.
﴿فمنهم من هدى الله ومنهم من حقت عليه الضلالة﴾: the fāʾ is consequential (tafrīʿiyya) and resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿مَن﴾ is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and it is a qualified indefinite (nakira mawṣūfa); the clause ﴿هدى الله﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿مَن﴾; and ﴿منهم من حقت عليه الضلالة﴾ is conjoined to the preceding one, and it is parsed like it.
﴿فسيروا في الأرض فانظروا كيف كان عاقبة المكذبين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿سيروا﴾; ﴿فانظروا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and انظروا is an imperative verb and agent; ﴿كيف﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative as the fronted khabar of ﴿كان﴾; and عاقبة المكذبين is its postponed noun (ism).

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿إن تحرص على هداهم فإن الله لا يهدي من يضل﴾: إن is conditional; تحرص is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿على هداهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿تحرص﴾, i.e. "you desire it"; فإن: the fāʾ links (rābiṭa) the apodosis, إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); the clause لا يهدي is its khabar (predicate); ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause يضل is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. It is also said that the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, and the clause ﴿فإن الله لا يهدي﴾ gives the reason for the apodosis, the implied form being: "neither you nor anyone else is able to guide them".
﴿وما لهم من ناصرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is negative; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿من﴾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition [i.e. redundant]; and ﴿ناصرين﴾ is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative in position and genitive by ﴿من﴾ in form.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿وأقسموا بالله جهد أيمانهم﴾: ﴿وأقسموا﴾ is a verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to أقسموا; جهد: a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "they swore by Allah, exerting themselves in their oaths", or it stands as deputy for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it has the meaning of the maṣdar, the meaning being: "they swore a swearing of exertion in the oath". أيمانهم: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause ﴿أقسموا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿وقال الذين أشركوا﴾, or is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) with no grammatical position.
﴿لا يبعث الله من يموت بلى وعدا عليه حقا﴾: لا is negative; ﴿يبعث الله من يموت﴾ is a verb, agent and object; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the oath; ﴿بلى﴾ is a particle of answer, to cancel the negation of the resurrection; ﴿وعدا﴾ is a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb. ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿وعدا﴾. ﴿حقًّا﴾ is a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, emphasising the content of the clause, the implied form being: «حق ذلك حقا» ("that is truly true"); or ﴿حقا﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of the maṣdar before it.
﴿ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون﴾: the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿لكن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); أكثر is its noun (ism); and the clause لا يعلمون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿ليبين لهم الذي يختلفون فيه﴾: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl); ﴿يبين﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to what بلى indicates, i.e. "He will resurrect them in order to make clear"; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يبين﴾; ﴿الذي﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause يختلفون فيه is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; and ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يختلفون﴾.
﴿وليعلم الذين كفروا﴾: ﴿وليعلم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ليبين﴾; الذين is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause كفروا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿أنهم كانوا كاذبين﴾: أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the hāʾ is its noun (ism); كانوا is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; the wāw is its noun; كاذبين is its khabar (predicate); the clause كانوا is the khabar of أن; and أن and what falls in its scope fill the place of the two objects of يعلم.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t: ﴿إنما قولنا لشيء إذا أردناه أن نقول له كن فيكون﴾: إنما is [إنّ] restrained [from governing] by [ما] the restraining [particle] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); ﴿قولنا﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لشيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿قولنا﴾; ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿قولنا﴾; the clause ﴿أردناه﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن﴾ and what it governs is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿قولنا﴾; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نقول﴾; كن is an imperative verb from the complete (tāmma) كان; the clause ﴿كن﴾ is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿فيكون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and يكون is conjoined to something implied, i.e. "so We say that to it, and it is"; or it is the answer to an omitted condition, so the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, i.e. "so when We say that, it comes to be"; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿والذين هاجروا في الله من بعد ما ظلموا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause هاجروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿في الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿هاجروا﴾, and ﴿في﴾ is causal; ﴿من بعد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), interpreted together with what it governs as a maṣdar that is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿لنبوئنهم في الدنيا حسنة﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an implied (muqaddar) oath; the clause ﴿نبوئنهم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of الذين; ﴿في الدنيا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; and ﴿حسنة﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "a good settling", so it stands as deputy for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); or it is the second object of ﴿نبوئنهم﴾, since it contains the meaning of «نعطينهم» ("We will surely give them"), and so it is a naʿt of something omitted, i.e. "a good abode".
﴿ولأجر الآخرة أكبر لو كانوا يعلمون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); أجر الآخرة is the mubtadaʾ; أكبر is the khabar; لو is conditional; ﴿كانوا﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; the wāw is its noun (ism); and the clause يعلمون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t: ﴿الذين صبروا وعلى ربهم يتوكلون﴾: الذين is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), in the position of a nominative, i.e. "they are those who were patient"; or it is in the position of an accusative by way of praise, i.e. "I mean those who were patient"; the clause صبروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿على ربهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يتوكلون﴾; and يتوكلون is an imperfect verb and fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿وما أرسلنا من قبلك إلا رجالا نوحي إليهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or resumptive; ما is negative; أرسلنا is a verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿من قبلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); إلا is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); رجالًا is the object of أرسلنا; the clause نوحي إليهم is a naʿt (adjective); and the clause ﴿وما أرسلنا...﴾ is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position.
﴿فاسألوا أهل الذكر إن كنتم لا تعلمون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; اسألوا is an imperative verb and agent; أهل الذكر is its object; إن is conditional; كنتم is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by ﴿فاسألوا﴾; ﴿كنتم﴾ is a defective, abrogating past verb; the tāʾ is its noun (ism); and the clause ﴿لا تعلمون﴾ is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿بالبينات والزبر وأنزلنا إليك الذكر لتبين للناس﴾: ﴿بالبينات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to أرسلنا; or attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رجالًا﴾, i.e. "men invested with clear proofs"; or to an implied أرسلنا; or to ﴿نوحي﴾, i.e. "We reveal to them with clear proofs"; أنزلنا is conjoined to أرسلنا; ﴿إليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أنزلنا﴾; الذكر is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لتبين﴾: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and تبين is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أنزلنا﴾; and ﴿للناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تبين﴾.
﴿ما نزل إليهم ولعلهم يتفكرون﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is the object of ﴿تبين﴾; ﴿إليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نزل﴾; the clause ﴿نزل إليهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿ولعلهم﴾: لعل is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun (ism), and the clause يتفكرون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿أفأمن الذين مكروا السيئات أن يخسف الله بهم الأرض﴾: the hamza is for the rebuking interrogative of denial (istifhām inkārī tawbīkhī); the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted; ﴿أمن الذين﴾ is a verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause مكروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿السيئات﴾ stands as deputy for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar, i.e. "they plot the evil plots"; or it is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), on the basis that ﴿يمكرون﴾ is made to contain the meaning of «يعملون» ("they do") or «يكسبون» ("they earn"); ﴿أن يخسف﴾: أن and what falls in its scope is a maṣdar that is the object of ﴿أمن﴾. It is also said that ﴿السيئات﴾ is the direct object of ﴿أمن﴾, i.e. "they felt secure from the evil punishments", and ﴿أن يخسف﴾, أن and what falls in its scope, is a badal (substitute) from السيئات. ﴿الله﴾ is the agent of يخسف; ﴿بهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يخسف﴾; and الأرض is the direct object.
﴿أو يأتيهم العذاب من حيث لا يشعرون﴾: conjoined to أن يخسف; ﴿من حيث﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause ﴿لا يشعرون﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:46-46.t: ﴿أو يأخذهم في تقلبهم فما هم بمعجزين﴾: likewise conjoined to أن يخسف; ﴿في تقلبهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object; the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative [ما] that governs as ليس does; ﴿هم﴾ is the noun (ism) of ما; and ﴿بمعجزين﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition [i.e. redundant], and ﴿معجزين﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive by the bāʾ in form.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿أو يأخذهم على تخوف﴾: a third conjoining to ﴿أن يخسف﴾; ﴿على تخوف﴾ is likewise a ḥāl (circumstantial), of the agent or of the object, i.e. "He seizes them, diminishing them bit by bit", or: "while they are in fear".
﴿فإن ربكم لرءوف رحيم﴾: the fāʾ gives the reason for what precedes; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ربكم is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); رءوف is the first khabar (predicate) of إن, and رحيم is the second khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿أولم يروا إلى ما خلق الله من شيء يتفيأ ظلاله عن اليمين والشمائل سجدا لله وهم داخرون﴾: the hamza is for the rebuking interrogative of denial (istifhām inkārī tawbīkhī); the wāw conjoins to something omitted and implied, i.e. "have they not looked and not seen, directing [their gaze] to what Allah has created"; ﴿إلى ما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يروا﴾; the clause ﴿خلق الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿من شيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿ما خلق الله﴾; the clause ﴿يتفيأ ظلاله﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of شيء, and ظلاله is the fāʿil (agent) of يتفيأ; ﴿عن اليمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, and الشمائل is conjoined; or [they are] attached to ﴿يتفيأ﴾.
﴿سجدا لله وهم داخرون﴾: ﴿سجدًا﴾ is a ḥāl of ظلاله; the wāw is circumstantial; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); داخرون is the khabar (predicate); and the clause is a ḥāl of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in ﴿سجدًا﴾, so it is an overlapping ḥāl (ḥāl mutadākhila).

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿ولله يسجد ما في السماوات وما في الأرض من دابة والملائكة﴾: ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يسجد﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿يسجد﴾; ﴿في السماوات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; ﴿ما في الأرض﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ما في السماوات﴾; ﴿من دابة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted [word], accusative as an explanatory ḥāl (ḥāl mubayyina, circumstantial); and الملائكة is conjoined to ﴿ما﴾.
﴿وهم لا يستكبرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause ﴿لا يستكبرون﴾ is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:50-50.t: ﴿يخافون ربهم من فوقهم ويفعلون ما يؤمرون﴾: the clause يخافون is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun of يستكبرون, or a badal (substitute) from the clause ﴿لا يستكبرون﴾; ﴿يخافون ربهم﴾ is an imperfect verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من فوقهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl of ﴿ربهم﴾, i.e. "they fear their Lord, being high above it in rank" [Translator's note: the source has «عليها» ("above it", feminine); the referent is presumably "them" (عليهم)]; ﴿يفعلون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿يخافون﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is the direct object; and the clause يؤمرون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿وقال الله لا تتخذوا إلهين اثنين﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; ﴿قال الله﴾ is a verb and fāʿil (agent); لا is prohibitive; تتخذوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is the agent; ﴿إلهين﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and اثنين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿إلهين﴾; it is also said to be a tawkīd (emphasis) of ﴿إلهين﴾.
﴿إنما هو إله واحد﴾: إنما is [إنّ] restrained [from governing] by [ما] the restraining [particle] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿إله﴾ is the khabar (predicate); and واحد is a naʿt, likewise for emphasis.
﴿فإياي فارهبون﴾: ﴿فإياي﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the answer to an implied (muqaddar) condition; إياي is a detached pronoun in the position of an accusative as the direct object of an implied verb explained by the mentioned verb, its implied form being "fear" (ارهبوا); the clause ﴿إياي ارهبوا﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis of the implied condition, the implied form being: «إن رهبتم شيئًا فإياي ارهبوا» ("if you fear anything, then Me fear"). ﴿فارهبونِ﴾: the fāʾ is a connective (ṣila) for embellishment (tazyīn); ارهبونِ: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw of the plural is the agent; the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya); the omitted yāʾ of the first person is the object; and the clause ﴿ارهبونِ﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya) with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿وله ما في السماوات والأرض﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to His saying ﴿إنما هو إله واحد﴾; or the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿ما﴾ is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿في السماوات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and الأرض is conjoined to ﴿السماوات﴾.
﴿وله الدين واصبا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; الدين is the postponed mubtadaʾ; and ﴿واصبًا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun hidden (mustakinn) in the preposition and its genitive noun, the implied form being: "and the religion is established for Him, while being perpetual".
﴿أفغير الله تتقون﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of denial (istifhām inkārī); the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted; ﴿غير الله﴾ is the fronted object of ﴿تتقون﴾; and ﴿تتقون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿وما بكم من نعمة فمن الله﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is conditional, in the position of a nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) is omitted; ﴿بكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted verb of the condition; ﴿من نعمة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the conditional noun, and it is also said: a ḥāl of the pronoun in the preposition; the fāʾ links (rābiṭa) the apodosis; ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, the implied form being: «فهو من الله» ("then it is from Allah"); the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and the omitted verb of the condition together with the apodosis is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of ﴿ما﴾. It is also said that ﴿ما﴾ is a relative, the mubtadaʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted ṣila (relative clause), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; the khabar is His saying ﴿فمن الله﴾, and the fāʾ is linking because the relative contains the meaning of condition.
﴿ثم إذا مسكم الضر فإليه تجأرون﴾: ثم is a conjunction; إذا is a future adverb containing the meaning of condition, attached to the apodosis ﴿تجأرون﴾; مسكم is a verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿مسكم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); الضر is the postponed fāʿil (agent); the fāʾ is linking; ﴿إليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تجأرون﴾; تجأرون is an imperfect verb and agent; and the clause ﴿فإليه تجأرون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t: ﴿ثم إذا كشف الضر عنكم إذا فريق منكم بربهم يشركون﴾: ثم is a conjunction; إذا is a future adverb containing the meaning of condition, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted verb, its implied form being "some of you associate partners" (أشرك بعضكم); the clause ﴿كشف﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); الضر is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿عنكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كشف﴾; إذا is [the إذا] of surprise (fujāʾiyya), with no grammatical position; فريق is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿بربهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يشركون﴾; and the clause يشركون is the khabar (predicate) of فريق.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿ليكفروا بما آتيناهم فتمتعوا﴾: ﴿ليكفروا﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); يكفروا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يشركون﴾, i.e. "their associating partners is caused by their disbelief in their Lord". It is also said that the lām is the lām of becoming (ṣayrūra) or of consequence (ʿāqiba), i.e. "the consequence of their associating others with Allah is their ingratitude for the blessing, which is the removal of harm from them"; and the preposition and its genitive noun — consisting of the lām and the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb in ﴿ليكفروا﴾ — are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يكفروا﴾; the clause آتيناهم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and ﴿فتمتعوا﴾ is a clause governed by an omitted saying, i.e. "say to them, O Muhammad: enjoy yourselves".
﴿فسوف تعلمون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; سوف is a particle of futurity; ﴿تعلمون﴾ is a verb and fāʿil (agent); and its object is omitted, its implied form being "the outcome of that".
